correctness.rationale: For n≥2 nondegenerate observations, τ=m=min x_i is in allowed support, k≥1 data points attain m, r=n−k have positive residuals y_i. Direct product of the quoted model density yields profile λhat=n/S(σ) where S=Σ(sqrt(1+y_i/σ)−1)~Cσ^(−1/2), C=Σ_{y_i>0}sqrt(y_i)>0. Profile ℓ=nlog(n/S)−n−nlog(2σ)−(1/2)Σlog(1+y_i/σ) gives coefficient n/2−n+r/2=−k/2 on logσ, hence ℓ=−(k/2)logσ+O(1)→+∞ and λhat~n√σ/C→0. Therefore no finite unconstrained three-parameter maximum exists. Independent direct-vs-profile formula reconstruction and high-precision log-step checks for unique/tied minima corroborate, while proof is asymptotic for all nondegenerate samples. All-equal samples explicitly excluded.
